ONCE IT SHIPS, HOW LONG IS DELIVERY?
Delivery depends on your destination and shipping method. For U.S. orders, our published 4–6 BUSINESS DAYS FOR STANDARD and 2 BUSINESS DAYS FOR PRIORITY include fulfillment and delivery—they aren’t additional time after shipment. International delivery typically takes 8–25 BUSINESS DAYS, depending in part on customs.
